task_summary: Transform public-repository metadata TSV into a normalized FASTQ sample-sheet CSV, preserving sample/run identifiers, single-versus-paired layout, predicted FASTQ paths, and organism metadata, without path validation because reads were not uploaded.

steps.reason: Confirm the uploaded depository file is TSV before normalization, guarding against a file-type mismatch before sample-sheet preparation.

Normalize the repository metadata TSV into a FASTQ sample sheet preserving sample/run IDs, single-versus-paired layout, predicted FASTQ paths, and organism metadata; sample-sheet validation is intentionally not run because the referenced reads were not uploaded.
